g.text: layer pattern, bars every @ 600 along the path

svg.text: Detail D1: eave, roof to wall
Roof outer layer 80, printed with the rest of the
piece; cladding on the outside face (dashed line).
Zig-zag lattice 80 in a 160 zone; it touches the
outer layer and layer 2 every @ 600; the cells
between are open air pockets for ventilation.
Layer 2, 80: printed bead that curves to leave a
pocket for the bar.
Inner layer 1, 80, room side. Layers 1 and 2
together are the structural leaf: 160 at the base,
80 at the crown (layer 2 ends).
Rebar pocket Ø55 in the leaf, grouted after placing.
Roof bars R Ø12 every @ 600 along the path.
Knee bars B Ø12 every @ 600, one continuous bar over
the eave: 1100 down the wall pocket (laps wall bars
A), through the beam, 650 up the roof.
Ring bars Ø12 in the pocket zone every 300.
Ring beam 400 x 500, cast in place: 8 Ø16, closed
stirrups Ø10 / 150; wall bars A hook into it.
Embedded in the buttress notch.
Buttress 400 wide, 1000 from the inner face (600
beyond the wall), L-shaped around the ring beam; top
flush with the roof base at +2.50.
Wall 400 printed, same pattern as the roof; wall
bars A Ø16 run from the footing up into the beam and
end in a 160 hook (assumed).
